description: A male newsreel announcer straight out of a 1950s cinema newsreel or a vintage radio commercial, in his forties. Bright, booming, resonant mid pitch, brisk staccato delivery with theatrical emphasis on numbers and exclamations. Relentlessly upbeat and enthusiastic, a bit too cheerful, like a salesman who believes every word. Clean close-mic studio recording with no room echo.
text: Good evening, citizens, and welcome to the Calendar Journal! The Earth takes three hundred and sixty-five days to go once around the Sun. Almost! It actually takes about five hours and forty-nine minutes more. So every fourth year gets one extra day: the twenty-ninth of February. Simple, isn't it?
